title: Ode to Joy
note: Beethoven, Symphony No. 9 theme. Stepwise; the first song.

title: When the Saints Go Marching In
She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain
note: Repeated notes; group sing-along. Melody especially uncertain in phrases 3-4.

title: Oh! Susanna
note: Steps plus small leaps. Lyrics: later standard verses.

title: Auld Lang Syne
note: Sol-to-do leap at the start. Verse high confidence; chorus medium.

title: Drunken Sailor
note: D Dorian; tests the minor/mode setting.

title: Take Me Out to the Ball Game
note: Chromatic notes (G#, F#). 1908 lyrics. Second half especially uncertain.

title: Shenandoah
note: Long phrases, breath control, wide range.

title: God Rest You Merry, Gentlemen
note: E minor; a second minor-key song. Soprano line read from the Open Hymnal 2006 score (Stainer's 1918 setting, public domain). The second "comfort and joy;" ends on A as printed; the familiar tune sings a low D there.

title: Shchedryk (Carol of the Bells), layered
note: Original 4-part layering on the public-domain folk ostinato; not Leontovych's exact score.
